what_happened: In job vava, the user corrected Athena's first reading of a request that changes what the producer is told. The user said the reading would add text where there is almost no token room. The shared producer prompt (crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md) is composed into the study producer at 1276 of 1300 tokens. The change producer is at 1060 of 1300. The change verifier is at 1298 of 1300. The user redirected new producer instructions to the change capability's producer prompt or the rendered brief, net of anything removed. They also said not to add to the change verifier, and to check sizes with the budgets test. The correction came before the work went on.
cause: Prompt token budgets are measured only by a test the producer runs late. The reading stage is never shown the remaining room per prompt, or which prompts are shared between capabilities. So it can place new text in a shared or nearly full prompt, and only the user's knowledge of the numbers catches it. This is the same gap as the registered class. Here the correction came at the reading stage instead of the producer looping until its deadline.
prevention: Before a reading is accepted, run a check that computes the remaining token room for every composed prompt (producer per capability, verifier, and so on) and puts the table into the reading stage's context. Add a check that any reading or plan deliverable naming a prompt file has room for its estimated addition, or else says what is removed. Mark shared prompts with the capabilities that compose them. Refuse a reading that targets a prompt with less room than the addition.
proposed_request: Add a budget-headroom check to Athena's reading stage. (1) Add a command or function, backed by the same counting as `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets`, that lists each composed prompt (study producer, change producer, change verifier, and the rest) with its used and maximum tokens and its headroom. (2) Include that table in the context given to the reading stage. (3) When a reading names a prompt file to edit, check that the estimated added tokens, net of removals, fit within the headroom of every prompt composed from that file. If they do not, send the reading back with the numbers. Acceptance: a test shows a reading that adds 50 tokens to producer.md is refused with the 1276/1300 figure, and a reading that adds the same text to the change producer prompt passes. Do not change any prompt text. Add a CHANGELOG entry.
